summary: Dagana district is overwhelmingly forested, with forests covering 1,521.48 km², representing 88.3 % of the area.  Agriculture land accounts for 77.50 km² (4.5 %), while shrubs, meadows, and alpine scrubs cover 62.35 km² (3.6 %), 21.81 km² (1.3 %), and 20.15 km² (1.2 %) respectively.  Water bodies, sandy banks, landslides, rocky outcrops, built‑up, and non‑built‑up areas collectively occupy less than 1 % of the district.
